QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Castle] The Royal Truth
QuestInfo.0: The Mushking is contemplating what to do with the Prime Minister. Though he has committed treason twice, he used to be one of the king's most loyal subjects. Talk to the king.
QuestInfo.1: The Prime Minister was one of the most loyal subjects in the past. The Mushking wonders what happened. Ask the Prime Minister about what happened and why he turned.
QuestInfo.2: The Prime Minister said it all started when he had no choice but to leave his daughter at the Spore Hill. Then the shocking truth was revealed, that Violetta is his daughter!

0.0: Our crisis has ended, but I still haven't decided what to do with the Prime Minister. He did commit terrible treason, but he used to be one of the most loyal subjects I had. I want to hear what went wrong.
0.1: As king I should be objective, but as a mushroom I still have soft spots. Could you ask him what happened?

yes.0: Though the Prime Minister is now my enemy, he was once the closest friend I had. Please ask him what happened... but keep it secret that I asked you to do so.

no.0: Yes, I can't even understand why he turned out that way, so how would I expect you to understand?

1.0: #face0#Why did I do it? Because I am tired of this world and this kingdom keeping me down. I'm sure the king put you up to this, so let me tell you how it was THE KING HIMSELF that started all this!

default.0: Please ask the Prime Minister why he turned on us...
